requirement: Content-Security-Policy (CSP) must be configured where applicable to restrict allowed content sources.
prohibited: Serving HTML responses with no Content-Security-Policy header.
bad_example: # nginx.conf has no CSP header directive
remediation: Add an appropriately scoped Content-Security-Policy header.

requirement: X-Content-Type-Options must be set to 'nosniff' to prevent MIME-type sniffing.
bad_example: # header not present in server config
remediation: Add 'X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff' to the server configuration.

requirement: A Referrer-Policy header must be configured to limit referrer information leakage.
remediation: Add a Referrer-Policy header appropriate to the application's needs.

requirement: A Permissions-Policy (or clickjacking protection such as X-Frame-Options) must be implemented.
prohibited: Serving pages that can be freely framed by third-party sites, with no clickjacking protection.
remediation: Add X-Frame-Options and/or a Permissions-Policy header.
